notes.title: King of Seas Monsters Update now playable!
notes.notes:
Captains, Commanders, Chiefs!

Beware what lurks beneath...

King of Seas new Monsters Update is now playable on PC! This new content update harbors boss fights, sea creatures; new quests, encounters and more!

The monsters of the deep are awake, and they’re hungry: 
[previewyoutube=HMkbjNz2Lo8;full][/previewyoutube]

PC captains, we're pleased to share that mouse support will be included in this update! Following our Ready, Aim, Fire! update, we've been working hard to incorporate mouse support into King of Seas. We've had to revamp the infrastructure to enable this, hence the long wait for you patient folks.

https://i.imgur.com/VO38imH.jpg

The update includes additional quests and new creature encounters for players as they embark on an epic journey across procedurally generated open seas, work to clear their name, and engage in strategic navel combat to become the true king of the high seas.

https://i.imgur.com/MYD2IQI.jpg

The Monsters Update introduces several new quests in game which once triggered will summon mythical sea creatures including a Basilisk, Abyssal Fish, Cursed Golem, and Kraken for players to fight and loot. The update also includes guardian sharks and crabs that defend treasure and shipwrecks; friendly encounters with whales and killer whales out in the open ocean; modified requirements for some questlines making them easier to complete; mouse support on PC so players can navigate the menus, shoot cannons, and move the camera with a mouse; and big quality of life improvements to make the King of Seas experience better than ever.

https://i.imgur.com/Q8slFnd.jpg

Patch Notes


 Added sea monsters quest line -  Several New quests to summon and fight mythical sea creatures in Tortuga. Reach the location to start your Journey. Both for low level pirates and lvl 60 ones!
 Added legendary monster set - You can now collect new legendary equipment from the Sea Monsters

 4 New Unique monsters to fight and loot!
- Added boss fight: Basilisk
- Added boss fight: Abyssal Fish
- Added boss fight: Cursed Golem
- Added boss fight: Kraken

 Added guardian sharks near rare wreckships - Rare wreck ships are now protected by some ferocious sharks! Beware!
 Added guardian crabs near rare buried treasures - Crabs defend the buried treasures on the seaside! (Be careful they throw rocks!)
 Added aesthetic encounters - The sea was a little too empty so we have added several new friendly encounters like whales, killer whales, fantastic creatures and more!
 Modified the quest Rich Carpenter - We have lowered the requirements of “Rich Carpenter quest”. Less gold is needed to complete it. Less farming for everyone!
 Readjusted Exp Requirements - We have lowered the exp needed to reach level 60. You can now level up faster and reach the end game in a smoother way!
 Kill those tentacles! - You can now hit the random kraken tentacle spawn to avoid them! Don’t get hit anymore!
 Ability Balancing - We nerfed Welcome to Hell, Deadly Wake and Haunted Ship abilities to have a better balance during ship fights
 Various Bux Fixing
 New sounds and graphical effects

PC ONLY

 Added mouse support - You can now use a mouse to navigate through the menus, shoot cannons, move your camera around.



Set sail and become the King of Seas 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209410/King_of_Seas/

Arrr you ready?

notes.title: Mouse support coming soon with new content update!
notes.notes:
Captains, Commanders, Chiefs! 

We hope you've been having a prosperous time at sea, instilling fear into those that dare harbour the audacity to cross you. 

Following our Ready, Aim, Fire! update, we've been working hard to incorporate mouse support into King of Seas. We've had to revamp the infrastructure to enable this, hence the long wait for you patient folks. 

Mouse support will accompany an exciting new content update, which you'll be enjoying very, very soon!

Here's a tease of what's to come:

https://i.imgur.com/G2MWnfu.gif

The sea is full of unknown terrors!

Thank you for your feedback since release, and your patience whilst we've worked to address your concerns over mouse support.

We'll be back with the full details of this content update shortly!

notes.title: King of Seas Update - Ready, Aim, Fire!
notes.notes:
Captains of the mighty seas,

It's time to set sail into the vast abyss of the deep with the new King of Seas Update - Ready, Aim, Fire. This patch includes a plethora of fixes and enhancements to ensure that your pirate adventures are as riveting as they can be!  

Savvy?

All the information you need is below, best of luck out there mateys. Arrr you ready?


Cannon Line of Sight
https://i.imgur.com/Mo1ZjwP.gif
Now we're sucking diesel...
You and your crew will now have a line of sight for your cannons! Shiver me timbers.

Camera Rotation
https://i.imgur.com/YnW8NtO.gif
Now you can see your prey coming from all angles. 

Enhanced Graphics
https://i.imgur.com/gCTyb7m.gif
This update enhances an array of graphics effects!


Patch Notes


 Updated the credits
 Icons have been added to the compass that indicate ports and fishing spots. If you have a quest with a target, this will be visible on the compass too.
 Added on option to show fire trajectory lines if the fire button is held down
 Added Camera controls (camera rotation and fixed camera); if you press "Q" or "E" you will be able to rotate the camera, if you press "C" the camera will rotate with the ship
 New helm navigation in menus; if you go left the helm will rotate on the right and vice versa.
 The Options menu is now available in-game.
 A skip button has been added to dialogues.
 The combat tutorial has been improved with additional dialogues and explanations for mechanics.
 The kraken tentacle will now spawn further away from the player and has increased visibility
 The appearances of the Krakens have been tweaked so that the tentacle that is randomly found in the sea and the one that spawns through the ability "Tentacle Slam" are now different
 AI ship spawn rates have been tweaked and will now spawn further away from the player.
 The main menu’s appearance has been corrected to appear correctly on 21:9 ultrawide monitors.
 Menu tabs now have wraparound; you can now select over the end of a set of tabs to return to its start.
 The player will now unlock lower difficulty achievements if completing the game on a difficulty level higher than "ship boy"
 The player can now hide and show the game interface with an option in the pause menu.
 Item stats have been rebalanced
 Fixed an issue that could have caused a decrease in towns’ levels without an invasion taking place
 All ships are now available from the start of the game
 The spawn time of loot has been adjusted.
 Ghost ships will be found only at night; they will disappear at dawn
 All player ships now have a permanent sail auto-repair effect that is active out of combat and outside storms
 Increased visibility at night
 Improvements have been made to the AI.
 We have encouraged the parrots to no longer block quest text.
 The player can now sell equipped items in the carpenter shop
 There are now no restrictions on what equipment can be unequipped in the Inventory.
 When purchasing maps, the player’s money is now visible on-screen.
 A ‘Sell All’ option has been added to the Market.
 The ‘Damage Per Second’ icon has been normalised across the game.
 It is now possible to buy any pirate ship from any pirate town.
 The bank no longer stores resources. If players had already stored resources in the bank prior to this change, the banks will honour this agreement!
 AI now retreat after a long chase. Pirate hunters and ghost ships are an exception.
 Increased the drop rate of treasure maps
 The graphical effects of the ‘Looting’ skill have been improved.
 Fixed a rare crash that could be caused by killing the same naval commander twice
 Fixed a bug that causes the ship to stay still even if the sails are lowered
 When the player switches ships, it is possible your cargo bay is no longer large enough to hold all your resources; a message will now appear if you try to leave port.
 Added a ship stats page in the Carpenter menu.
 Fixed an error with the calculation of armour
 Added dialogues to better clarify the colours of the three factions
 Fixed a rare bug that could cause the deletion of the save file
 Fixed a rare bug where the save game was not deleted if the player dies in "King of Seas" mode
 Fixed a bug that caused a block after leaving a port
 Fixed a bug that caused a block after complete a secondary quest             
 Fixed a bug that caused the compass rotation to be incorrect when the player activated the fixed camera
 Fixed a bug that caused the AI to not give experience if killed in a single hit
 Fixed an incorrect icon in the controls page
 Fixed an incorrect icon for ship targets
 Numerous text fixes and QOL improvements.


Please share your feedback in the forums; we're always reading!

We hope you enjoy Ready, Aim, Fire! Plenty more on the way ;) 

Become the King of Seas:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209410/King_of_Seas/

notes.title: King of Seas PC Tech Update is now live!
notes.notes:
Captains, Commanders, Chiefs! 

Today, we're happy to report back to you and your crew that we have a new update, now live for King of Seas! The PC Tech Update includes a plethora of fixes and improvements to further enhance your experience out at sea! And yes, we have key rebinds! Mouse support is also on the horizon for a future update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38287618/73b0ff973eb34f72ed40c25c3d536e1193f2c86d.png

PC Tech Update



 Added support for full key rebinding functionality 

 Removed the lock on difficulty selection; all difficulties are immediately available to all players 

 Removed the 60FPS lock on the game (existing players need to disable Vsync and restart the game for this to take effect) 

 Fixed a crash when hit by a tentacle with the ‘Reflect Damage’ talent active 

 Fixed an issue where players were blocked if attempting to purchase a sloop 

 Fixed a rare issue where a fishing spot was not accessible 

 Fixed an issue where the sound that played on blocking an ability would play on loop 

 Fixed an issue that allowed items in the Bank to become Level 0 

 Fixed an issue that caused Pirate Hunters to behave incorrectly under certain circumstances 

 Fixed an issue where the incorrect resource was awarded for the completion of a Novice mission 

 Fixed an exploit that allowed players to gain additional rewards from Port Conquest missions 

 Fixed a rare crash that would occur if starting a mission 
	
 Additional bug fixes and quality of life improvements


Thank you for your continued patience whilst we continue to fine-tune King of Seas, and most importantly, work on new content!

Don't forget to check the Road Map! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38287618/fbdbd56e00a9691fa6810ed5505b129b2edb7c9a.png

Good luck out there!
